title: Harbour Lights
summary: A puzzle game about a lighthouse keeper, made by a studio of agents. Pre-production is signed off; the vertical slice is half done.

now.doing: The vertical slice: the first island, from the boat to the lamp
now.detail: The island's three puzzles are playable; its art is in review and its music is being written. 412 tests, none failing.
now.waiting: Your pick of the keeper's three designs, and a playtest of the first puzzle.
now.next: The slice, end to end, on Friday 23 October.

needsYou.title: Pick the keeper's design
needsYou.detail: Three designs are in art/keeper/: A is the old sailor, B the young apprentice, C the retired engineer.

needsYou.title: Playtest the first puzzle
needsYou.detail: About ten minutes. Say where you got stuck and where it was too easy.

decisions.decision: The puzzles never need fast fingers
decisions.why: It's a calm game; timing puzzles are about watching, not reflexes

log.text: The tide gates puzzle is done and merged, with its tests. The fog bell is playable; its timing is being tuned.
Three designs for the keeper are in for your pick.
Pre-production signed off by you: the three bibles.
